goal: Speed up balance calculation and coin selection for active wallets with extensive transaction histories
Avoid repeatedly scanning outputs that are already spent or conflicted
reviewability: Worth reviewing now because the rebase conflict with master is mechanical
agreement: Broad support for massive performance improvements on large wallets (remyers, w0xlt, Zeegaths)
Concept approval as a natural follow-up or pending performance verification (murchandamus, jonatack, rkrux)
Unaddressed objections: reorg balance omissions, assertion aborts, and db writes on load failure (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it cuts balance checking and coin selection overhead by orders of magnitude for active wallets
Synthetic benchmarks demonstrate up to 500x speedups by excluding spent historical outputs
